messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm kicking off the cloud account + VPC scaffold for the new 'ember' region (ember-1). Need GPU quota requests, VPC design, and handoff to platform. Starting checklist here. :wave:

sam: Nice. Quick wins — project name should be `redwood-ember-prod` per naming conv. I'll open the repo and a tiny terraform scaffold.

leo: Reminder: GPUs we usually request are A100-v4 and T4 for spot. Need SKU limits and regional availability check before we submit quota. Also, cost estimate?

anya: For networking: prefer shared-services VPC in this region, then per-project service VNet peering. Propose CIDR plan: shared 10.50.0.0/20, ember-prod 10.51.0.0/22, ember-staging 10.51.4.0/22. Keep a /28 per bastion. Thoughts?

maria: Agree on shared-services pattern. Keep NAT in shared-services for predictable egress, and route tables to deny direct internet from clusters unless via egress cluster.

sam: I'll sketch terraform module. Minimal commands to bootstrap account:

```
# create project
gcloud projects create redwood-ember-prod --name="Redwood Ember Prod"
# set billing
gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-ember-prod --billing-account=01A2BC-... 
# enable apis
gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com iam.googleapis.com cloudkms.googleapis.com
```

sam: Also create service account for infra: `sa-infra@redwood-ember-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and grant roles: `roles/compute.admin`, `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser`, `roles/servicemanagement.quotaAdmin`

leo: For GPU quota request, include these fields to cloud support: region=ember1, SKUs=[A100_V4, T4], per-SKU count, reason=platform-inference+dedicated-capacity. I can draft the support ticket.

anya: On VNets/subnets, add a note: set `private Google access` for subnets with cloud sql and artifact registry access. Also enable flow logs on shared-services subnets for 30 days retention.

infra-bot: Runbook linking: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/region-bootstrap — includes preflight, quotas, k8s bootstrap, post-handoff checklist. (automated comment :robot_face:)

maria: Action items:
- leo: draft and submit GPU quota ticket (by EOD)
- sam: new terraform repo + module PR (WIP)
- anya: finalize CIDR and NAT design, add to infra docs
- maria: request billing account linkage with finance

sam: I'll drop a skeleton repo and CI. Example terraform snippet for shared-vpc attachment: 

```
resource "google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project" "host" {
  project = var.host_project
}

resource "google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project" "service" {
  host_project    = var.host_project
  service_project = var.service_project
}
```

leo: Cost heads-up: A100-v4 reserved is ~X/day (ballpark). We'll need to decide reserved vs burst. I'll run a quick cost model and post numbers.

anya: For onprem connectivity later — keep an IP block reserved for VPN endpoints. Add /28 in shared-services for that use.

maria: Test cluster smoke checklist (sam/leo):
- create a small k8s cluster with 1 GPU node pool (spot)
- install calico/metrics + node-exporter
- run `kubectl get nodes` and `kubectl top nodes` to confirm GPU alloc
- run a sample inference container and watch latency + memory

sam: Example smoke commands I use after apply:
```
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl describe node <gpu-node> | grep -A3 -i "Allocatable"
kubectl run test-inf --image=redwood/inference-test:canary --requests=cpu=2,memory=4Gi --limits=nvidia.com/gpu=1 --restart=Never
kubectl logs -f pod/test-inf
```

leo: Also set up cloud monitoring dashboards for `gpu_utilization`, `nvml_temperature`, `gpu_mem_usage`. We should wire alerts for >95% memory or OOM patterns.

maria: Handoff plan: once quotas approved and terraform PR merged, schedule a 30-min ramp with platform to validate service endpoints and observability. Tag owners in PR and add `handoff:` label.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline queued for `terraform/ember-scaffold` — check https://ci.redwood/pipelines/ember-scaffold/12 :white_check_mark:

sam: PR is open: https://git.internal/infra/terraform-ember/pull/3 (WIP, still needs IAM and nat module) :eyes:

anya: One more networking nit — ensure subnet secondary ranges reserved for pods/services if we use GKE autopilot or VPC-native mode. Add `pods` and `services` secondary ranges.

maria: Good catch. I'll add that to the terraform variables.

leo: I'll post the GPU quota ticket draft in this thread once ready.

maria: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker post here. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:00 for status. :thumbsup:

sam: ACK. I'll ping once PR has tests passing.

leo: ACK — drafting ticket now.

anya: ACK — finalizing CIDR doc and uploading to docs repo.

infra-bot: Reminder: tag `oncall` for any emergency capacity requests after hours.
